notes: Added API, integration, and observability stories to complete feature coverage.

stories.title: Brain Lock Service API Endpoints
stories.description: Expose internal service endpoints for lock acquisition, renewal, release, and status check. Ensure idempotency and ownership validation on all operations.

stories.title: Brain Runner Integration with Lock Lifecycle
stories.description: Integrate lock acquisition, renewal heartbeat, and release into brain_runner and brain_loop execution flow to enforce single-writer execution and prevent concurrent assignment processing.

stories.title: Lock Observability and Audit Logging
stories.description: Implement structured logging and audit records for lock events (acquire, renew, expire, recover, conflict). Include timestamps, owner_id, and outcome for traceability and debugging.
